about_the_game:
Summary / overview

Start and manage your very own game studio in Game On! 

Start at the bottom of the industry as a solo developer and work your way up to becoming a globally respected game studio. Design hit games, manage your staff and research upgrades to stay at pole position in the competitive race to the #1 world ranking. 

Key Features

  • Manage your own company!

    Balance your finances, hire and train staff members, manage game projects, research new features and technologies, participate in side contracts, and set up your own servers. 

  • Design your masterpiece-games!

    Craft hit games across multiple genres, follow gaming trends and win over fans. Make crucial decisions during game development to create the perfect game combinations that align with market trends. Experience the thrill of publishing your game creations and await the verdict of reviewers. 

  • Assemble and manage your dream team!

    Recruit and train staff members, ranging from programmers, designers, animators, and audio engineers to community managers. Satisfy your staff's needs to keep them happy, or risk losing them to resignation! 

  • Facilitate your workflow!

    Be sure to maintain a good office atmosphere by decorating for seasonal cheer, filling the printing machines with enough paper, and ensuring there's enough coffee for your staff!

  • Customization and endless gameplay!

    Customize your character and set up your studio's name and logo. Rebrand at any time if you need to. As long as you keep rolling in the money, you can remain in business forever!

Will you become the next rockstar of the gaming industry, or will your studio fade into obscurity? The world is watching - get ready to GameOn!

Other Features

  • Enjoy 60+ custom music tracks while playing.

  • Enjoy gameplay scenes with dynamic surroundings, whimsical animations, and fun Easter Eggs.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Run your own video-game studio in this engaging simulation! Design hit games, manage your team, and compete with rival studios for the global ranking. Balance your finances and research new upgrades. Follow market trends to build your legacy as the ultimate game development master! Let's GameOn!
